# `prefer-memcpy`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports a full-range element loop that copies `source[index]` to a distinct
`destination[index]`.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

`@memcpy` names the operation and asserts the equal-length contract.

## When it fires

Source and destination must be distinct direct bindings and the body must
contain only the corresponding store. Exact matches receive a fix-all rewrite.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn copy() void {
    var dst: [4]u8 = undefined;
    const src = [_]u8{ 1, 2, 3, 4 };
    for (0..dst.len) |j| {
        dst[j] = src[j];
    }
}
```
